air_performance.interpretation: Under the exploratory operational rule AIR ≥9 positive and AIR 0–8 negative, 32 of 77 histopathology-positive cases were test-positive and 45 were below the cutoff. Sensitivity was 41.6% (95% Wilson interval 31.2% to 52.7%); specificity was 100.0% among 8 reference-negative cases, with 0 false positives. Overall accuracy was 47.1%. Intermediate scores were retained in the lower-score group for this operational comparison, rather than establishing a clinical absence-of-disease classification. Predictive values reflect this operated cohort; an infinite LR+ with zero false positives does not prove perfect population specificity. The three-category cross-tabulation remains the direct description of the requested risk bands.
